entities.name: Marcelo Domínguez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marcelo Fabián Domínguez is an Argentine former professional boxer who competed from 1991 to 2015. He held the World Boxing Council (WBC) cruiserweight title from 1996 to 1998. At regional level, he held the Argentinian cruiserweight title from 1993 to 1994, and Argentinian heavyweight title from 2002 to 2007.
